_comment: UIC dataviz style: one look for every chart in the course notebooks, Python (matplotlib) or C++ (hpcViz.h). It formalizes labHelpers.applyHouseStyle(): the same Okabe-Ito series colors, sizes, grid and axes, plus validated dark-mode steps, text colors from uicTheme.css, and sequential/diverging maps for fields. Sizes are in points, as matplotlib uses them; the SVG charts convert them to pixels at figure.dpi (1 pt = dpi/72 px), so both render the same at the same figure size. Titles are left-aligned. Change values here, not in code.
_categoricalNotes: Okabe-Ito, first six slots in labHelpers order; validated (dataviz validator) on #FFFFFF and #111418. Okabe-Ito yellow #F0E442 and black are not used for series (yellow disappears on white, black is text). Slots 3 and 4 (green, pink) are close for deuteranopes, so series always also differ by marker shape, and charts carry a legend and direct labels. More than six series: fold into 'other' or use small multiples; ordered ids (threads, ranks) beyond six use the sequential ramp.
